approved: Income Tax Rates Amendment (Temporary Budget Repair Levy) Bill 2014
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill is part of a package that introduces a three-year temporary budget repair levy starting in the 2014-15 financial year.
The levy would add a two per cent tax on taxable income above $180,000 for Australian resident and foreign resident individuals.
The levy would also apply to certain tax rates linked to the top personal marginal tax rate and the Medicare levy.
Introduces a temporary budget repair levy as additional income tax for individuals.
Applies the levy to tax rates based on the top personal marginal rate and the Medicare levy.
Sets the levy rate at two per cent for taxable income over $180,000.
Australian resident and foreign resident individuals with taxable income over $180,000.

Introduced the Income Tax Rates Amendment (Temporary Budget Repair Levy) Bill 2014, which inserts a new schedule into the Income Tax Rates Act 1986 setting the levy at two per cent on taxable income above $180,000 for the 2014 to 2015, 2015 to 2016 and 2016 to 2017 financial years.
